title: Nvidia considers cosigning loan for Nscale data center
excerpt: Nvidia is reportedly weighing acting as a cosigner for a loan to fund Nscale's artificial intelligence data center in West Virginia.
body_html:
Nvidia is considering acting as a cosigner for a loan supporting Nscale's planned artificial intelligence data center project located in West Virginia. The potential financial backing comes at a time when investors are showing nervousness regarding overall spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.

By potentially offering to cosign the loan, the chipmaker is exploring ways to support the development of the new West Virginia facility, which is designated for artificial intelligence workloads.
